title: Alejandra M NDE 4244
content: I was at the hospital with my mother and I remember I was nervous or scared since they were going to draw some of my blood. I suddenly started to feel sick and at this point, I fell down to the floor. Suddenly I was standing in front of a black swirl and moving ahead to cross it - to reach out to a bright light that was getting larger as I moved towards it. I quickly entered that light and saw bright, faceless people with human form, who I did not know but felt they knew me because of the friendly way in which they received me. I had the feeling that one of them was my late uncle that I loved so much. These entities received me with great joy and greeted me by my name, but all this dialogue was by telepathy. I was not talking, and they did not have voices either. I also remember feeling a sensation of peace, welfare and happiness beyond description. It was as if I belonged to that place. Suddenly, the voice of my conscience told me that it was not my time yet and that I had to return. But, I did not want to go back as I was so comfortable. I resisted and I felt as though someone was pulling me from somewhere else. I pulled in the opposite direction, but this force was stronger than I was. I heard from far away the voices of people and the doctor who were around me, increasingly clear, until I regained consciousness. I was sitting, head down, and the doctor was putting pressure on my neck. I recall that in those first moments, I felt angry and frustrated about not being able to stay in this wonderful place. Since that day, I thought that if THIS was death I had no more reason to fear it. I used to have a great fear of death. I told all this to my mother at the time, but she thought it was just a dream and that at no time did the doctor speak of a loss of pulse or anything like that. I spoke about this with almost nobody, since even the people who I thought could understand it believe this is a fantasy of mine, or look at me in a strange way. Nobody really believes it.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: moving ahead to cross it toward a bright light that was getting larger

arrival.other_being_detail: bright, faceless people with human form (unknown to experiencer) who greeted her

environment.environment_other_detail: black swirl leading into a bright light; presence of 'bright, faceless people with human form'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: felt pulled back by a stronger force; then heard voices increasingly clearly until regaining consciousness

context.nde_cause_other_detail: fainted/brief loss of consciousness during blood draw at hospital

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: black swirl passage; greeted by bright faceless beings and possibly late uncle; telepathic greeting by name; conscience said it was not her time; resisted being pulled back; returned hearing voices/doctor
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Swirl/passage to growing light, then beings; return initiated by 'voice of my conscience' saying it was not her time, followed by being pulled back.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Return decision/message came from 'the voice of my conscience' rather than an external being; beings were 'bright, faceless people with human form'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly I was standing in front of a black swirl…”; “These entities received me with great joy and greeted me by my name, but all this dialogue was by telepathy.”; “It was not my time yet and that I had to return.”; “I used to have a great fear of death.”
